metadata.description: Open-source GattyWorks data-protection audit skills. The India DPDPA skill is the current product.

plugins.name: dpdpa-india
plugins.description: Open-source GattyWorks audit for India's DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025. Includes 49 checks, code evidence patterns, a fixed report contract, penalty mapping, and 13 policy-artifact specifications.
